rules.body_markdown: The game ends when one player wins the game. When you win, your Rival loses.
rules.title: The game ends when one player wins the game.

rules.body_markdown: The game ends when one player loses the game. When you lose, your Rival wins.
rules.title: The game ends when one player loses the game.

rules.body_markdown: If you have seven (7) or more Gig dice in the friendly Gig area at the start of your turn, you win the game.
rules.title: If you have seven (7) or more Gig dice in the friendly Gig area at the start of your turn, you win the game.

rules.body_markdown: The game checks this win condition before the first step of your Start Phase (the Ready Step).
rules.title: The game checks this win condition before the first step of your Start Phase (the Ready Step).

rules.body_markdown: In overtime, if you have seven (7) or more Gig dice in the friendly Gig area at any point, you immediately win the game.
rules.title: In overtime, if you have seven (7) or more Gig dice in the friendly Gig area at any point, you immediately win the game.

rules.body_markdown: Overtime begins after two consecutive turns in which both players begin with an empty fixer area. (Usually, after both players have completed 7 turns each.)
rules.title: Overtime begins after two consecutive turns in which both players begin with an empty fixer area.

rules.body_markdown: If you already have seven (7) or more Gig dice in the friendly Gig area when overtime begins, you win immediately.
rules.title: If you already have seven (7) or more Gig dice in the friendly Gig area when overtime begins, you win immediately.

rules.body_markdown: Winning the game occurs instantly, even in the middle of a game action or effect resolution.
rules.title: Winning the game occurs instantly, even in the middle of a game action or effect resolution.

rules.body_markdown: If both players win simultaneously, the game is considered a tie.
rules.title: If both players win simultaneously, the game is considered a tie.

rules.body_markdown: When you must draw a card from an empty deck (i.e. there are 0 cards in your deck area), you lose immediately.

If you attempt to draw more cards than remain in your deck, the first card you cannot draw counts as drawing from an empty deck. See [Draw](#rule-b07d7e94-c69d-5162-a49c-f77241f8d44b).

> **EXAMPLE:** A card effect says “Draw 2,” but you only have 1 card left in your deck area. You draw the first card, and attempt to draw the second card. The deck is now empty, so you lose immediately.

rules.body_markdown: Losing the game occurs instantly, even in the middle of a game action or effect resolution.

rules.body_markdown: To steal a Gig is to take control of a rival Gig, such that it becomes a friendly Gig.
rules.title: To steal a Gig is to take control of a rival Gig, such that it becomes a friendly Gig.

rules.body_markdown: Whenever a Gig is stolen, there is an “actor” that steals it.
rules.title: Whenever a Gig is stolen, there is an “actor” that steals it.

rules.body_markdown: When a Unit/Legend attacks to steal a Gig, they are the actor, the one doing the stealing
rules.title: When a Unit/Legend attacks to steal a Gig, they are the actor, the one doing the stealing

rules.body_markdown: If card text specifies a different actor, the specified actor is the one that steals.
rules.title: If card text specifies a different actor, the specified actor is the one that steals.

rules.body_markdown: When you or a friendly actor steals one or more Gig(s), follow these steps in order.
rules.title: When you or a friendly actor steals one or more Gig(s), follow these steps in order.

rules.body_markdown: Choose the rival Gig(s) to steal.
rules.title: Choose the rival Gig(s) to steal.

rules.body_markdown: Move the Gig(s) to your Gig area.
rules.title: Move the Gig(s) to your Gig area.

rules.body_markdown: When an actor steals multiple Gigs simultaneously, choose the Gigs first, then move them all at the same time.
rules.title: When an actor steals multiple Gigs simultaneously, choose the Gigs first, then move them all at the same time.

rules.body_markdown: You take control of the Gig(s). They become friendly Gigs.
rules.title: You take control of the Gig(s).

rules.body_markdown: If a card effect triggers when a Gig is stolen, resolve the effect after the Gig changes control.
rules.title: If a card effect triggers when a Gig is stolen, resolve the effect after the Gig changes control.

rules.body_markdown:
If a card effect triggers when a Gig would be stolen, resolve the effect after the Gig is selected, but before the Gig changes control.

> **EXAMPLE:** A Unit’s card text reads “When a rival Unit would steal a Gig, you may discard 1 with cost equal to that Gig's value. If you do, the Gig isn't stolen.” A rival Unit attacks your Gig area to steal 2 Gigs. Your Rival chooses to steal Gigs with values 3 and 10. You discard a card with cost 3, so the rival Unit only steals the value 10 Gig.

rules.body_markdown: A Gig’s value can’t change during stealing. If an effect adjusts the Gig’s value, you must resolve it either before choosing the Gig(s), or after the Gig(s) change control.
rules.title: A Gig’s value can’t change during stealing.

rules.body_markdown: Your 6-set of polyhedral dice must contain one of each: a four-sided (d4), six-sided (d6), eight-sided (d8), ten-sided (d10), twelve-sided (d12), and twenty-sided (d20) die.

rules.body_markdown: Your dice must be balanced: all of a die’s faces must have an equal chance of occurring on a properly randomized roll.
rules.title: Your dice must be balanced: all of a die’s faces must have an equal chance of occurring on a properly randomized roll.

rules.body_markdown: Numbers on all die faces must be legible to both players.
rules.title: Numbers on all die faces must be legible to both players.

rules.body_markdown: When a die is in play, its current value must be immediately obvious to both players without significant discernment.
rules.title: When a die is in play, its current value must be immediately obvious to both players without significant discernment.

rules.body_markdown: Your dice must follow current regulations for the game format.

rules.body_markdown: Your turn consists of two phases. It progresses in order: Start Phase, Main Phase.
rules.title: Your turn consists of two phases.

rules.body_markdown: Your turn concludes with an automatic “End of Turn” check after your Main Phase, but before the start of your Rival’s turn.

rules.title: When your turn starts, your Start Phase begins immediately.

rules.body_markdown: Check if you control 7 Gig Dice. See [GAME OVERVIEW](#rule-0ef7599d-d21e-5efb-bb17-375f7950991c) > [Win Conditions](#rule-8008d6a4-9033-5412-931f-d669c00fade1).

rules.body_markdown: If you take any action out of order, immediately complete any previous missed actions before taking any new ones.

rules.body_markdown: After you complete all Start phase actions, the Main phase immediately begins.

rules.body_markdown: At any point during your Main phase while you are not taking an action, you may choose to pass your turn to your Rival. When you do, immediately begin the [End of Turn](#rule-5cf5dfb4-f5b3-57c9-b846-99ceef96783e) check.

rules.body_markdown: The number of Gigs an attacker steals is based on its power.
rules.title: The number of Gigs an attacker steals is based on its power.

rules.body_markdown: If the attacking Unit has 0 power, it steals 0 Gigs.
rules.title: If the attacking Unit has 0 power, it steals 0 Gigs.

rules.body_markdown:
If the attacking Unit has 1 or more power, it steals X Gigs (rounded down) according to this formula, where P = the attacking Unit’s power.

`X = (P / 10) + 1)`

> **EXAMPLE:** A Unit with 1 to 9 power steals 1 Gig. A Unit with 10 to 19 power steals 2 Gigs. Continue this pattern for higher power values.

qualification.result: Measure both original Fixer pools at the turn-start boundary, before Start Phase effects/Ready/Draw/roll. Retain consecutive starts; a nonqualifying next start resets to zero.

entry.result: Complete end-turn effects, then expire this-turn effects, then enter overtime before rival turn starts. TURN_ENDED records the completed turn before OVERTIME_STARTED.

win.result: Seven or more controlled Gig dice at entry or any later control-count transition wins immediately; no new player action.

multiSteal.result: Choices are sequential; movement/control changes are simultaneous. Do not win on selecting the first of two Gigs. Complete the atomic transfer then finish before post-combat MAIN/trigger decisions.

simultaneous.result: Formal rule says tie, but two seven-Gig controllers are impossible with the admitted twelve-object pool. Reject malformed extra dice; do not implement a generic tie extension.

limitations: No new start-of-turn card effects or Gig-return/creation effects admitted. Qualification does not assume future Fixer monotonicity.
